adapter_contract.generation_instruction: If a tool is needed, output only JSON: a single object or array of objects with name and arguments. Otherwise answer normally.
adapter_contract.history: Same lossless role normalization as v1.1. A common semantic history/tool-output adapter is held fixed across model families; each model still renders that semantic history through its own pinned native Hugging Face chat template.
adapter_contract.name: canonical_json_adapter_v1_2
adapter_contract.parser: Strict JSON only; accepts one object or an array; no code-fence stripping, regex recovery, argument coercion, or retries for malformed model output.
adapter_contract.purpose: Hold the tool interface fixed across Qwen/Llama/Gemma for cross-model replay-stability replication.
adapter_contract.smoke_gate: 3/3 exact synthetic structured calls after a 26/26 live /v1/chat/completions/render preflight. The synthetic history includes the tool-result→user adjacency that caused the Gemma v1 HTTP 400.
adapter_contract.tool_schema: AgentDojo 0.1.35 Function JSON schema from runtime.functions.

amendment.required_clean_comparison: All three fresh arms must be rerun under v1.1. Any v1 Llama results are provenance/technical-pilot only and are not pooled with v1.1.
amendment.trigger: Gemma first scientific request returned HTTP 400 before model generation: Conversation roles must alternate user/assistant/user/assistant/...

changes: Require one immutable Hugging Face model/tokenizer revision lock for all three arms.
Launch every model with --revision and --tokenizer-revision from that lock.
Launch every model with --generation-config vllm to avoid repository-specific generation defaults.
Require 26/26 exact raw-prefix live chat-template renders via /v1/chat/completions/render before smoke or baseline.
Use explicit request temperature=0, top_p=1, seed=0, max_tokens=1024 for smoke/baseline.
Freeze and verify the live server process command line before scientific baseline.
amendment_v1_2.status: prospectively frozen before v1.2 scientific outcomes
amendment_v1_2.supersession_rule: All cross-model v1/v1.1 outputs are technical/provenance only. The joint scientific comparison uses only v1.2 arms.

changes: Adds a prospectively frozen secondary argument-role replay-volatility endpoint.
Adds a frozen field-to-role taxonomy covering every target argument in all 26 decisions.
Adds within-decision paired contrasts OPEN_TEXT-REFERENCE_IDENTITY and STRUCTURED_SCALAR-REFERENCE_IDENTITY.
Adds deterministic argument/action-structure analysis and joint three-model reporting.
amendment_v1_3.claim_boundary: The new endpoint measures exact replay volatility by argument role. It is not semantic-equivalence evidence and does not by itself establish a class-wide flaw in replay/counterfactual defenses.
amendment_v1_3.origin: discovery-derived from prior post-hoc P2b-v1/AttriGuard diagnostics
amendment_v1_3.timing: frozen before any authoritative v1.3 scientific model outcome

completion_rule: Run all three fresh canonical-adapter arms regardless of earlier arm outcomes; no outcome-dependent stopping.
